prose: I caught up with Eileen McKusick at Music N Sky, and decided it's high time for another interview, live and direct! Eileen is the founder of the Biofield Tuning Store, and a researcher-cartographer of the human energetic anatomy. This time we'll talk about her new discoveries in Sonic Alchemy, the power of your voice to transform dissonant discomfort to harmonic health, balanced moderate Hedonism, and more.
